notes.title: Interactive Movie Engine's ready for Next Fest! | Project Crowdfunding Countdown
notes.content:
Dear creators and players:

Thank you very much for your attention and support for [i]Interactive Movie Engine[/i]!

Good news: Interactive Movie Engine has been registered for the Steam Next Fest in June. Free game demo is ready for you to play at that time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458450/86dc4b10ee203e92b0eb82da7fbcada803de199c.jpg[/img]

And the project crowdfunding has been launched on the Modian platform. Thanks for the enthusiastic support of every supporter!
[url=https://zhongchou.modian.com/item/138221]Click here to view the crowdfunding project[/url]

Small tip: Add [i]Interactive Movie Engine[/i] to your wishlist to get the game launch news in time~

Thank you again for your optimism and suggestions for [i]Interactive Movie Engine[/i]! More features are under development, so stay tuned~
